spans.s:
n. (-ण्डं)
1 An egg.
2 A testicle or the scrotum.
3 Semen genitale.
4 The musk bag, regarded as the scrotum of the deer.
E.
अम to go, and ड Uṇādi aff.

n. (-ण्डं)
A multitude of eggs, &c.
E.
अण्ड and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
The scrotum.
E.
अण्ड scrotum, and कन् aff.

f. (-ष्पा)
A plant, (perhaps Convolvulus argenteus.) See अजन्त्री.

m. (-षः)
1 The scrotum.
2 The testicle.
3 A boundary.
4 The rind of a fruit.
5 Fruit.
E.
अण्ड a testicle, and कोश or कोष a sheathe.

m. (-कः)
The scrotum.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Oviparous.
m. (-जः)
1 A serpent.
2 A fish.
3 A bird.
4 A lizard.
f. (-जा)
Musk.
E.
अण्ड an egg, &c. and ज what is born, from जन.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Egg-shaped, oval, elliptical.
m. (-रः)
An oval, an ellipsis; also अण्डाकृति, &c.

m. (-लुः)
A fish.
E.
अण्ड, and आलु, aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A man.
2 Strong, powerful.
E.
अण्ड, and ईर aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Having many eggs, &c.
E.
आण्ड and ईरच् aff.
